newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato says 97 budget revenue to rise 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato says 97 budget revenue to rise 6 pct.

text.p: The Spanish government's 1997 budget draft foresees a rise in government revenue of six percent, Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Friday.

"Revenues will increase one basis point below nominal growth, that is by 5.98 or 5.99 percent, around six percent," said Rato at a press briefing following a cabinet meeting during which the government approved the budget draft.
Revenue from privatisations would be 50 billion pesetas less than the previous Socialist government had forecast, he added.
